name: KB Components AB (publ)
summary: KB Components AB specializes in the creation, refinement, and production of plastic components. The company furnishes polymer-based parts meticulously engineered for interior, exterior, and powertrain applications within both light and heavy vehicle sectors. Furthermore, the firm delivers extensive engineering and manufacturing solutions, encompassing system and concept development, precise design and geometry, material specification, industrialization, logistics management, advanced production methodologies, and comprehensive operational support. Its diverse operational footprint spans segments such as light vehicles, heavy vehicles, medical, industrial, furniture, chrome plating, industrial windows, and lighting. Founded by Anders Manson in 1947, KB Components AB maintains its headquarters in Orkelljunga, Sweden.
